title: OpenBao Secrets Management
description: Hands-on OpenBao: deploy it on Kubernetes, watch it come up sealed and understand why, unseal it with Shamir key shares, then store secrets in K/V v2 and learn which kinds of deletion you can undo. Accompanies the full course at https://devoriales.com/quiz/27/openbao-secrets-management-production-operations-on-kubernetes
